title: State procurement.
bodyText: All state and county agencies that purchase or lease any electronic device shall require each prospective offeror to certify compliance with this part. Failure to provide certification shall disqualify the prospective offeror.
bodyHtml: §339D-27  State procurement.  All state and county agencies that purchase or lease any electronic device shall require each prospective offeror to certify compliance with this part.  Failure to provide certification shall disqualify the prospective offeror. [L 2009, c 183, pt of §6; am L 2022, c 151, §16]
